info.title: OpenMap REST API
info.description: The REST face of OpenMap (ADR-049). GraphQL at /graphql covers everything else.

get.summary: List current CIs, filtered like the CMDB screen, one cursor page at a time.

patch.summary: Set attributes on a CI as a person's edit (user-label confidence); keys absent from the body are kept.

get.summary: A CI's current relationships: downstream (what it depends on), upstream (what depends on it) or both.
What a failure of the CI would reach (upstream) or what it depends on (downstream), with the business services.

post.summary: Create a relationship as a person's edit.

delete.summary: Retire a relationship (it stays in history with validTo set).

get.summary: Full-text search over CIs (names, codes, identity values, attributes).
Incidents of business services, open ones by default.
Sites, inter-site links with their latest probes, and the HA / DR readiness findings.
